Kids Bible Class · August — Week 2

Wonderfully Me

Genesis 1:27; Psalm 139:13-14

“How you made me is amazing and wonderful.”

Psalm 139:14 (NIrV)

God carefully made you, and you are wonderful.

Image 1

Long before you were born, God already knew all about you.

He planned for you and could not wait for you to be here.

Image 2

God carefully made every part of you.

Your bright eyes, your happy smile, your wiggly fingers and toes — God made them all.

Image 3

God gave you your very own laugh and your very own voice.

He gave you your own way of thinking and the things you love to do.

Image 4

Look around — everyone is different!

There is no one else in the whole world exactly like you.

Image 5

You are not an accident.

God made you carefully, on purpose, and with love.

You are wonderfully made!

What We Learn

God made every single part of you on purpose — your face, your laugh, the way you think. There is no one else in the whole world exactly like you. You are not an accident; you are wonderfully made.

For you: When you feel like you wish you were more like someone else, remember God made YOU on purpose and loves who He made. You are wonderful just as you are.
